text: At 34 minutes, Marek Barros had a great chance for Harbour City after Joon Whitfield's clever through ball set him up close to goal. Barros took a quick shot from just 5.7 meters, but the defender got in the way to block it. This was a big moment from Harbour City's patient passing style, showing their focus on careful build-up play. The score stayed 0-0, but that chance almost changed everything[#672] [#669] [#670].
